scope: Re-ran the five most consequential checks: (1) counts, (2) sizes, (3) sample content at Billings, (4) all 23 terms quotes against live pages, (5) the recommendation's legal basis. Every claim is marked confirmed, refuted, corrected or unverified.
method: Live curl requests through the configured proxy into per-source folders under scratch-refute-temperature-alternatives/downloads, each under 60 MB (largest 13856867 bytes). PRISM zips extracted into fresh folders and read with numpy using the BIL headers. GHCN .dly parsed by fixed columns; the S3 CSV and ghcnd-stations.txt parsed directly. Daymet and gridMET read from single-pixel CSV and OPeNDAP ASCII, with CF scale and offset applied from the DAS. Terms quotes matched against live HTML and pdftotext output after normalising spacing around punctuation. Analysis scripts are in scratch-refute-temperature-alternatives/scripts and were run with python -I. The 800 m PRISM zip was HEAD-checked only. Downloads were deleted after this record was written.
bottom_line: Most measured values reproduce exactly and all 23 terms quotes appear on the live pages. The recommendation's direction stands. Corrections: the distances to the airport (1.8 to 4.3 km, not 0.8 to 1.3 km); the airport-nearest comparison (June 15 tmax -3.0 to -0.5 F, not -3.0 to +1.2 F; July totals 0.56 to 0.59 in above the airport at those cells); the gridMET legal basis (PRISM attribution is a condition); the decision 7 citation; and the nClimGrid clause, which has no nClimGrid measurement behind it.
recommendation_note: The recommendation stands in direction: no alternative replaces nClimGrid-Daily as the baseline; gridMET comes first as a supplement and Daymet second, conditional on its licence; PRISM stays off the layer list on the public-domain preference (a policy call); NOAA normals and Climate at a Glance stay context only. Four points must be fixed before the record is relied on. (1) The airport comparison: the sampled cells are 1.8 to 4.3 km from the GHCN airport station, and the June 15 tmax range should read -3.0 to -0.5 F at the cells nearest the airport. (2) The gridMET legal basis must make PRISM attribution a condition, because gridMET blends PRISM and OSU keeps PRISM ownership. (3) The decision 7 citation is not in docs/DECISIONS.md; cite the research prompt's Decision 7 (Follow the laws) or the decision text itself once located. (4) The do-not-replace nClimGrid clause has no nClimGrid measurement behind it, and nClimGrid is itself built from GHCNd, so the airport station cannot test it; restate it as a decision on licence, lag and coverage, or add a held-out-station test.

S3 CSV: 393,178 rows, last TMAX 2025-02-06, no June or July 2025 rows. Daymet: 61 rows for June 1 to July 31 and 16,790 rows for 1980 to 2025 (46 x 365), no 2026 rows. gridMET 2026 file: 290 days.
five_checks.2_sizes: Confirmed for every re-fetched file: the four PRISM zips to the byte; S3 CSV 13,856,867; .dly 4,625,370; Daymet CSVs 2,065, 2,045 and 425,149. 17 of 17 page and PDF sizes match the record (one within 1 byte). Not measured: the 800 m PRISM zip (HEAD only). Stored-download total: the fetch log sums to 35,849,757, not 35,849,254 (corrected, immaterial). This refuter's downloads: 43396257 bytes across 59 files, largest 13856867, all under 60 MB; deleted.
five_checks.3_sample_content: Values confirmed for the PRISM Billings, airport and Benchland cells, GHCN 2025-06-15 and July 2025, Daymet Billings and Benchland, and gridMET Billings and Benchland. Corrected: the distances (cells are 1.8 to 4.3 km from the airport, not 0.8 to 1.3 km), and the June 15 tmax range at the airport, which is -3.0 to -0.5 F using the cells nearest the airport, not -3.0 to +1.2 F.
five_checks.4_terms_quotes: 23 of 23 quotes found on the live pages after normalising spacing around punctuation. 14 match exactly as extracted; the other 9 differ only in spacing. Wording confirmed for every quote.
five_checks.5_legal_basis: PRISM: not public domain (OSU ownership) and free reproduction and distribution with attribution, both confirmed. gridMET: waiver and 'free of known copyright restrictions' confirmed, but gridMET blends PRISM spatial patterns, so PRISM attribution must be a condition (corrected). Daymet: 'openly shared, without restriction' and the EOSDIS sponsor-licence clause confirmed; the ORNL/DOE licence was not found, so the conditional stands. The decision 7 citation is wrong for this repo (corrected). NOAA: no NCEI terms found; 17 U.S.C. section 105 not addressed (open).

checks.claim: Recommendation 1 legal basis for gridMET: author waiver plus attribution
checks.detail: The waiver covers the author's rights in gridMET. gridMET blends PRISM spatial patterns, and PRISM's terms reserve ownership to OSU and require attribution (name, URL, date of access).
